text:
Tyler: Planned rollout of 'soft-preemptive-eviction' on low-priority GPU pools today 23:00-00:30 UTC. Canaries in west-1 only. Purpose: lower p99 latency during noisy bursts by preemptively throttling queues before hard eviction. Thresholds: circuit-breaker at 85% GPU mem, queue-delay cap 300ms. We'll ramp 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 10m holds and automated safety checks.
Maria: Ack. what's the backout plan?
Tyler: Backout: disable feature flag -> `redwood feature toggle soft_preempt off --env prod --region west-1`. If quick rollback needed: `kubectl -n redwood label node pool=lowprio --overwrite remove=soft-preempt` or restart worker pods.
Sam: What dashboards/alerts should we watch?
Tyler: Watch these: p99 request latency (route: /v1/generate) ; request queue length per pool; GPU mem pressure; error-rate; SLO burn. Dashboard: https://console.internal/dashboards/soft-preempt (internal). Alert triggers: SLO burn > 1.2 for 5m, p99 +30% over baseline for 5m, queue length > 250.
OpsBot: Scheduled deployment job #deploy-3789 queued for 2026-03-24T23:00:00Z :alarm_clock:
Maria: I'll own the west-1 canary. I'll call for backout if SLO burn > 1.3 or p99 spikes >40%.
Sam: I'll watch controlplane logs and routing. Will run small synthetic traffic if you want.
Tyler: Please run the synthetic: `wrk -t4 -c50 -d600s --latency https://ingress-west1.redwood.internal/v1/generate` during holds. Post a short snip of p99 numbers.
Sam: Running synthetic now during 5% hold. Will post p99 after 3 minutes.
OpsBot: Canary rollout: 5% -> pass hold -> escalating to 25% in 10m. Canary result: pass. :white_check_mark:
Tyler: OK starting 25% ramp, hold 10m. If no flags we'll complete to 100% after final hold. Rolling back instruction repeated: `redwood feature toggle soft_preempt off` and `kubectl -n redwood rollout restart deploy/worker --selector=pool=lowprio`.
Maria: 25% hold stable. p99 baseline 72ms -> current 88ms. SLO burn at 1.06. continuing.
Sam: Noting a small uptick in queued requests on one node, investigating. If it looks like a KV-cache warmup issue, we'll trigger per-prefix cache-warmup policy.
Tyler: Thanks. Standby for 30m post-rollout monitoring. If anyone sees SLO burn >1.5, call incident channel and start backout immediately. :triangular_flag_on_post:
Maria: Ack, monitoring.
Sam: Ack, standing by.
